# Spektrafilm source conformance

`conformance.json` contains controlled observations from executed upstream spektrafilm at revision `3bb2c2d2801ff68b92019cf1dbcbb133d60832bc`. The [exporter](../../../scripts/spektrafilm/export.py) generates them alongside the [runtime data](../../../assets/spektrafilm/README.md).

For every selectable camera-negative/print-medium pair, eight supplied AP1 inputs exercise neutral, coloured, signed, HDR and zero-light cases. Observations include film exposure, developed density, paper exposure/density and the pre-inverse authoring-reference RGB. Paper-only cases exercise the declared positive-to-paper adapter separately.

Native tests compare source stage observations and composed viewed output. Shared preprocessing and calibration functions make these tests upstream-model conformance, not independent physical-film measurements. All colour media's paper-only observations use a SciPy moment solve for the declared convex spectral reference and original spectral Y before the scanner's numeric log-zero epsilon. Fixture-only photometry retains the dye/base, viewing illuminant and CIE-Y integration basis. Native tests exercise the moment constraints, receiver integration, low-positive continuation, neutral trajectory and colour-dependent luminance separately. The reference selects a spectrum under an explicit prior; matching its readings does not recover a measured negative. The reference RGB is obtained before inverse encoding, allowing the GPU forward reference to test the native sampled scanner/inverse component.

`supra-original.json` captures a 5³ Supra paper-only numeric asset from main commit `f0749f9d80d9c28b98fb0430f4c253c630bbeb11`, before the input/readout calibration update. It tests that saved samples remain authoritative even when their catalogue labels still exist; it is not an appearance target for new generation.

No photographs or scanner-device measurements are included. Spektrafilm data derivatives retain the attribution and CC BY-SA terms in [the source-data notice](../../../assets/spektrafilm/LICENSE-data.txt). The historical Academy reference and implementation-covenant attribution are described in the [runtime-data guide](../../../assets/spektrafilm/README.md), with the [original Academy notice](../../../assets/spektrafilm/NOTICE-Academy-APD.txt) retained separately.
